dates.name: Old Crow Medicine Show — Twilight Concert Series
dates.desc: Grammy-winning Americana and folk-rock legends! High-energy, joyful live show perfect for summer outdoor concerts. Known for incredible fiddle work and feel-good music. Bring a blanket, relax, enjoy great musicians under the stars.

dates.name: Gin Blossoms & Blues Traveler — Red Butte Garden Concert
dates.desc: Two iconic bands of the '90s! Gin Blossoms bring 'Hey Jealousy' energy with fun, melodic rock. Blues Traveler delivers harmonica-driven jam excellence. Great night of nostalgia and high-energy music in the beautiful Red Butte Garden amphitheater.
dates.where: Red Butte Garden Amphitheatre — 300 Wakara Way, Salt Lake City, UT 84108

dates.name: Rainbow Kitten Surprise — 'Bones' Tour
dates.desc: Eclectic indie-rock band with energetic, soulful live performances. Experimental, artistic sound with passionate fans. Great for couples who appreciate unique, creative music. Summer outdoor amphitheater setting is perfect.

dates.name: Salt Lake Bees vs Reno Aces — Baseball Homestand
dates.desc: Summer baseball! The Bees begin a homestand with games against the Reno Aces. Perfect for a relaxed, fun evening with snacks, activities, and competitive sports. Your kind of casual date night.
dates.where: The Ballpark at America First Square — Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Deer Valley Music Festival — Beethoven's Symphony No. 9
dates.desc: World-class performance of one of music's greatest masterpieces! Utah Symphony with conductor Markus Poschner, full chorus, and vocal soloists perform Beethoven's iconic Symphony No. 9 with the 'Ode to Joy.' Breathtaking mountain setting, stunning performance.
dates.where: Snow Park Outdoor Amphitheater — Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Salt Lake Bees vs Reno Aces — Afternoon Baseball Game
dates.desc: Saturday matinee baseball! Enjoy afternoon sports, sunshine, and summertime fun. Casual atmosphere with food, drinks, and entertainment. Perfect for an easygoing date.
dates.where: The Ballpark at America First Square — Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Food Truck Warz — Thanksgiving Point Festival
dates.desc: Epic battle between food trucks! Multiple gourmet food trucks compete for bragging rights. Sample diverse cuisines, enjoy outdoor festival vibes, and support local culinary talent. Fun, casual, and delicious.
dates.where: Electric Park at Thanksgiving Point — 2650 N Ashton Blvd, Lehi, UT 84043

dates.name: Marcus King — Red Butte Garden Concert
dates.desc: Southern rock/soul legend Marcus King brings high-energy, passionate performances with incredible guitar work. Known for powerful vocals and authentic musicianship. Beautiful Red Butte Garden setting makes this a perfect summer evening.
dates.where: Red Butte Garden Amphitheatre — 300 Wakara Way, Salt Lake City, UT 84108

dates.name: Maren Morris — Red Butte Garden Concert
dates.desc: Country/pop superstar Maren Morris delivering a captivating performance of hits and new music. Known for powerful vocals, infectious energy, and connection with audiences. Perfect romantic summer evening in the gorgeous garden setting.
dates.where: Red Butte Garden Amphitheatre — 300 Wakara Way, Salt Lake City, UT 84108

dates.name: JOJI: 'Solaris' Tour — Maverik Center
dates.desc: Electronic/R&B innovator JOJI bringing atmospheric, soulful performances. Known for creating immersive concert experiences with stunning visuals. Perfect for couples who love contemporary music and artistic performances.
dates.where: Maverik Center — 301 S Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Deer Valley Music Festival — Mozart & Violin Concerto
dates.desc: Utah Symphony presents Mozart's 'Jupiter' Symphony and Violin Concerto No. 2 performed by acclaimed soloist. Elegant classical music in a breathtaking outdoor mountain amphitheater. Pure romance and world-class artistry.
dates.where: Snow Park Outdoor Amphitheater — Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: The String Cheese Incident — Red Butte Garden Concert
dates.desc: Jam band masters The String Cheese Incident deliver energetic, improvisational performances. Known for long sets, musical exploration, and dancing audiences. Perfect for a fun, high-energy musical evening.
dates.where: Red Butte Garden Amphitheatre — 300 Wakara Way, Salt Lake City, UT 84108

dates.name: Deer Valley Music Festival — Stravinsky's Firebird Suite
dates.desc: Utah Symphony performs Stravinsky's bold, colorful 'Firebird Suite' and other masterpieces. Conductor Markus Poschner leads this spectacular performance combining Russian-inspired music with stunning mountain views. Magical summer evening.
dates.where: Snow Park Outdoor Amphitheater — Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Totally Tubular Festival — Red Butte Garden (80s & 90s Nostalgia)
dates.desc: Epic '80s and '90s festival featuring Thomas Dolby, A Flock of Seagulls, The Motels, and more! Pure nostalgia with energetic performances from iconic bands. Dance under the stars to the soundtrack of your youth. Fun, campy, and absolutely entertaining.
dates.where: Red Butte Garden Amphitheatre — 300 Wakara Way, Salt Lake City, UT 84108

dates.name: Rockport or Strawberry Reservoir — Summer Alpine Lake Adventure
dates.desc: July is perfect for alpine lake dates! Crystal-clear waters, warm summer days, and mountain views. Choose between Rockport Reservoir (1 hr north) or Strawberry Reservoir for kayaking, paddleboarding, fishing, or shoreline picnicking. Your favorite type of exploration date.
dates.where: Rockport State Park (Coalville, UT) or Strawberry Reservoir (Wasatch National Forest, UT)

dates.name: Park City Trail Network — Mountain Biking or Hiking Adventure
dates.desc: Park City has 400+ miles of scenic mountain trails! Perfect July weather for exploring. Choose easy to challenging hikes or bike rides with stunning views of wildflowers and mountain scenery. Various difficulty levels for all abilities.
dates.where: Park City Mountain Resort & Trail Network — Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Stewart Falls Trail — Sundance Mountain Waterfall Hike
dates.desc: Moderate 3.5-mile mountain hike through shaded aspen forest to a stunning two-tiered waterfall. Beautiful July weather, cool mountain air, and picturesque alpine setting. Perfect romantic hiking date.
dates.where: Sundance Resort — 8841 Alpine Loop Rd, Sundance, UT 84604 (45 min south)

dates.name: Antelope Island State Park — Wildlife & Sunset Scenic Loop
dates.desc: Drive or hike the 7-mile scenic loop spotting native bison herds, pronghorn, and bighorn sheep. July offers clear skies for stunning Great Salt Lake sunset views. Peaceful, scenic, and perfect for your love of exploration dates.
dates.where: Antelope Island State Park — 4528 W 1700 S, Syracuse, UT 84075 (45 min north)

dates.name: Snowbird Alpine Tram — Mountain Peak Scenic Ride
dates.desc: Ride the 2,000-foot aerial tram to Hidden Peak (11,000 ft) for breathtaking 360° views of the Wasatch Mountains. Great July weather, cool alpine air, and stunning vistas. Option to dine at the summit restaurant.
dates.where: Snowbird Resort — Little Cottonwood Canyon, UT (45 min east)

dates.name: Dinner at Handle — Park City Seasonal Chef's Menu
dates.desc: Intimate, chef-driven restaurant featuring Dave Jones' celebrated seasonal small plates. Fresh fish, heritage meats, creative vegetables. Excellent wine list. Perfect romantic atmosphere with outdoor patio option for summer dining.
dates.where: Handle — 412 Main St, Park City, UT 84060 (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Dinner at Log Haven — Millcreek Canyon Fine Dining
dates.desc: Scenic mountain setting four miles up Millcreek Canyon with refreshing alpine air. Chef Dave Jones' sophisticated seasonal menu, beautiful mountain views, excellent service. Perfect summer escape.
dates.where: Log Haven — 6451 Mill Canyon Rd, Salt Lake City, UT 84121 (15 min south)

dates.name: Dinner at The Tree Room — Sundance Mountain Fine Dining
dates.desc: Tucked into the mountains at Sundance with cool alpine breezes. Seasonal American cuisine, mountain views, rustic elegance, exceptional service. Romantic summer escape from the heat.
dates.where: The Tree Room — Sundance Resort, 8841 Alpine Loop Rd, Sundance, UT 84604

dates.name: Chuck Wagon Dinner — Sundance Horseback & Cowboy Meal
dates.desc: Unique combination! Scenic horseback ride through alpine meadows, then authentic cowboy dinner at Elk Meadows. Casual fun, great views, and delicious food. Perfect for active outdoor couples.
dates.where: Sundance Resort — 8841 Alpine Loop Rd, Sundance, UT 84604

dates.name: Outdoor Movie Night — Ashton Gardens Thanksgiving Point
dates.desc: Bring a blanket, grab popcorn and dinner, and enjoy a family-friendly movie under the stars at beautiful Ashton Gardens. Summer evening atmosphere, scenic garden backdrop. Fun and romantic outdoor experience.
dates.where: Ashton Gardens at Thanksgiving Point — Lehi, UT (25 min south)

dates.name: Broadway Theater Productions — Eccles Theater
dates.desc: World-class theatrical performances! You loved Phantom of the Opera (5 stars)—check Eccles schedule for similarly stunning musicals and shows. Hell's Kitchen is performing early July, and other Broadway tours happen throughout the summer.
dates.where: Eccles Theater — 131 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Deer Valley Music Festival — Utah Symphony Classical Concerts
dates.desc: World-class orchestra performances in stunning outdoor mountain amphitheater! July features Beethoven, Mozart, Stravinsky, and renowned soloists. Romantic, breathtaking mountain setting. Bring a blanket and enjoy sophistication with nature.
dates.where: Snow Park Outdoor Amphitheater — Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Natural History Museum of Utah — Paleontology & Discovery
dates.desc: World-class museum with 60,000+ fossils, interactive exhibits, stunning valley views. Educational, fascinating, perfect for exploration and learning together. Cool indoor escape from summer heat.
dates.where: Natural History Museum of Utah — 301 S 1300 E, Salt Lake City, UT 84112

dates.name: Red Butte Garden — Botanical Gardens & Outdoor Concerts
dates.desc: Utah's premier botanical garden with summer concerts under the stars. Beautiful garden pathways, peaceful atmosphere, world-class outdoor concert venue. Perfect romantic summer evening.
dates.where: Red Butte Garden Amphitheatre — 300 Wakara Way, Salt Lake City, UT 84108

dates.name: Salt Lake Arts District Gallery Walk — Downtown Art Exploration
dates.desc: Explore vibrant downtown arts district with local artists, contemporary installations, and rotating exhibits. Grab coffee at nearby cafes, discuss art together, discover new creative work. Perfect for culture-loving couples.
dates.where: Salt Lake City Arts District & Gallery Row — Downtown SLC

dates.name: Horseback Riding at Sundance — Alpine Mountain Trail Rides
dates.desc: Guided horseback rides through stunning Sundance mountain trails with wildflower meadows and alpine overlooks. July weather is perfect—cool mountain air, beautiful scenery. Beginner-friendly with experienced guides.
dates.where: Sundance Resort — 8841 Alpine Loop Rd, Sundance, UT 84604 (45 min south)

dates.name: TopGolf Vineyard — Gamified Golf & Friendly Competition
dates.desc: Private bay with automatic scoring, full bar, great food. Zero golf skill required—just fun, friendly competition, laughter, and summer evening vibes. Relaxed, upbeat date night energy.
dates.where: TopGolf — 484 N Entertainment Way, Vineyard, UT 84087

dates.name: Escape Room Challenge — Puzzle & Teamwork Experience
dates.desc: 60-minute immersive puzzle experience with themed rooms. Solve puzzles together, race the clock, enjoy teamwork and challenge. Great for competitive couples—you'll love the problem-solving fun.
dates.where: Getout Games — 202 W 400 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Indoor Rock Climbing — Beginner-Friendly Gym
dates.desc: Indoor climbing gym with varied difficulty levels perfect for all abilities. Great for teamwork, mutual encouragement, and friendly competition. Cool indoor escape from summer heat.
dates.where: Local climbing gyms throughout Salt Lake City (multiple locations)

dates.name: Summer Outdoor Sports — Tennis or Pickleball
dates.desc: Perfect July weather for outdoor tennis or pickleball! Fun, competitive, low-pressure activity. Great exercise and plenty of laughs. Multiple courts available around the valley.
dates.where: Various parks throughout Salt Lake City, Park City, and Lehi

dates.name: Imaginaria Festival — Ashton Gardens Interactive Experience
dates.desc: Immersive festival transforming 50-acre Ashton Gardens into extraordinary play zones and themed experiences. Fun, interactive, unique. Perfect for couples who enjoy creative, unconventional dates.
dates.where: Ashton Gardens at Thanksgiving Point — Lehi, UT (25 min south)

dates.name: Twilight Concert Series — Free Outdoor Summer Music
dates.desc: Free outdoor concerts with nationally recognized and local artists throughout July and beyond. Bring a blanket, picnic, and enjoy live music under the stars. Perfect summer evening—romantic and budget-friendly.
dates.where: Gallivan Center — 239 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Live Comedy Night — Stand-Up Comedy Club
dates.desc: Live stand-up comedy at local venues. Great laughs, casual fun atmosphere, perfect evening of entertainment. Low-pressure fun and connection—you'll laugh together.
dates.where: The Wiseguys Comedy Club — 250 S West Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Park Silly Sunday Market — Outdoor Craft & Music Festival
dates.desc: Monthly outdoor market in Park City with local artists, crafts, food vendors, and live music. Fun, quirky, artistic vibe. Perfect for supporting local creators and enjoying summer Sunday atmosphere.
dates.where: Park City Main Street — Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Hot Air Balloon Sunrise Flight — Aerial Mountain Adventure
dates.desc: Magical sunrise hot air balloon flight over Utah landscapes and mountains. Floating peacefully with panoramic views, then champagne breakfast at landing. Romantic, unforgettable bucket-list experience.
dates.where: Various launch sites near Salt Lake City (arrange through tour operators)
